verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for an AI-agent observability platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public source repository or an open license for Bento itself. Skills and rules stored in the user's repo as Markdown/YAML are the user's own content, not product source, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
